title: Station Bursar desk at The Experiment: neon made into ionized neon by hand, the pilot's own surplus ionized neon and liquid nitrogen listed under the station's asks, a 15-minute docked watch
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 01:14 UTC (orders ENT-084 block MERCURY: capital crafts under 500 cr a ship-hour, the dearer cut; no trader waits docked, F8; F40 alarm: 0 Bursar ships of 5). Replaces craft-sell-neon-experiment (-1,062 cr a ship-hour, hive.py briefing 01:01 UTC). The station's book (table books 01:10 UTC): neon_gas asked 1 cr x 72,123; asks ionized_neon 34 x 43, liquid_nitrogen 22 x 45 (bid 3 x 30). Traders' storage here (table holdings 01:10 UTC): ionized neon 16,128 (25 pilots), liquid nitrogen 1,732 (3). Listed at 30 and 20, floors 3 and 4. max_jumps 3 as the craft it replaces. Docked, no jump: 0 fuel; the craft (60 neon or 64 oxygen bought at 1 cr, about 61 to 65 cr a run) gives Crafting XP, and the 15-minute desk watch (watch_minutes, fixed in e7cf857a) keeps each run near 18 minutes, so a ship-hour costs about 200 cr, under the 500 cr cap of orders ENT-084 block MERCURY. No stop_on_failed_buy: once the 1 cr ask is gone the buy takes nothing, nothing is made and the desk still lists and watches at no cost. sell_order lists only the pilot's own surplus above every bid (rule F12, F24: stock view=surplus 01:11 UTC: ionized neon 33,892 surplus of 42,886, liquid nitrogen 67,481 against max 232, liquid oxygen 3,993 all surplus); fills come later at the station, outside the run's credits; every order in contracts.log (F39). No undercut_pct: our own asks would undercut each other down to the floor. standing: desk work, not judged on its pay (F22).
